evidence.name: Screen field: The image for this screen
evidence.userNeed: Know what "The image for this screen" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: The image for this screen
sections.description: Add this screen's image by uploading a file from your computer or pasting a direct image URL, then confirm it in the preview. Use a high-quality JPG or PNG that's on-message for the screen — uploads are optimized automatically for fast loading on every device. To replace it later, upload or paste a new source here.
